notes.content:

notes.title: Development Update 1
notes.content:
A quick update on My Space's development progress. 

I'm working on the effects of quality, and lack of quality, in the game. Low skill bartenders, cooks, and other staff and low quality appliances can lead to customers getting sick. When this happens, it can cascade into more problems.

[previewyoutube=4AScgc7dYgI;full][/previewyoutube]

In the above video, the first customer gets sick from his drink. This lowers his opinion of this experience, which will result in less money. The next customer then slips in the sick and falls. He will also have a very poor opinion of his experience. You can clean up any messes by clicking on them and moving the mouse to scrub it clean. There will be a notification for things like this when they happen!

In the next update I'll talk about the resources you earn and how they are spent.

If you have any questions or comments please feel free to post in the forums!

-Jonathan "Calandryll" Hanna
